inline:The target refutes itself by claiming the 3-of-26 result is explained by 'temporal ordering' while simultaneously asserting it is explained by 'one-author confound' — these are mutually exclusive mechanisms that cannot both be the operative variable.
The target states the 3-of-26 result is 'an artifact of mutation proposal order and guard installation order in one repository' (temporal mechanism), then immediately states this is 'the specific temporal mechanism behind SRC_003's one-author, one-week confound'. But temporal ordering and author identity are orthogonal variables: the same temporal sequence can be enforced by different authors (via policy or tooling), and different temporal sequences can arise from the same author. The target conflates 'when things happened' (temporal) with 'who made them happen' (authorship) as if specifying one explains the other, when in fact they are competing causal stories.
